orderBasis: Qualitative approximate order across general enterprise documents, PPTs, business applications and websites; not measured usage or market share. Adjacent rankings have no statistical significance.

sources.role: Microsoft official source distinguishes regular/filled system icons and product/file icon uses; supports simple functional symbols as broad-use baseline, not exact ranks.
Google official source documents fill, weight and optical-size variants; supports line/fill baseline, not adoption rates.

styles.treatment: Flat frontal uniform medium navy strokes, rounded caps and joins, empty interiors, no shading, no fill except a tiny cobalt cue. Functional and precise.
styles.useJa: 案内、操作の補助、簡潔な資料
styles.traitsJa: 均一な線、塗りなし

styles.treatment: Flat filled cobalt silhouettes with ivory cut details, simple smooth geometric forms, NO enclosing outlines, NO gradients, no shadows.
styles.useJa: 機能の一覧、社内文書、Web
styles.traitsJa: 輪郭線を省いた幾何形

styles.treatment: Flat frontal strong navy outlines, finer inner strokes, cobalt and pale-blue solid faces; no gradients, no dimension.
styles.useJa: 業務の説明、研修、提案書
styles.traitsJa: 濃い輪郭と少量の色面

styles.treatment: Bold continuous navy silhouettes with incisive ivory negative-space apertures. Navy dominates; no contours, no texture; visibly stronger figure-ground than ordinary blue flat icons.
styles.useJa: 強いシルエット、単色印刷
styles.traitsJa: 抜きの形で意味を作る

styles.treatment: Precise frontal technical line drawings, graded dark exterior and finer internal strokes; a few very restrained drafting construction guides, no microtext, no wash or shading.
styles.useJa: 技術の概念、構造の説明
styles.traitsJa: 外形と内部の線を分ける

styles.treatment: Match the supplied Technical Spot reference's smooth graded blue-gray contours, restrained filled surfaces, light tonal modeling, credible object structure and slight illustrative character. Focused small objects, not a full scene, no construction guides, no rough hatching, no pedestal.
styles.useJa: 具体的な物やサービスの説明
styles.traitsJa: 分級の輪郭、控えめな色面と明暗
styles.comparisonTreatment: Same four metaphors and captions as other regular panels; graded outlines, restrained fills and soft tonal modeling without rigid isometric extrusion.

styles.treatment: Crisp frontal 2D silhouettes with controlled cobalt-to-pale-blue gradients on FLAT faces, NO actual extrusion, NO plastic volume, NO hard outlines, no glow. Distinct from fully modeled matte 3D.
styles.useJa: デジタル製品や能力の紹介
styles.traitsJa: 平面の中の滑らかな色変化

styles.treatment: A consistent shallow 30-degree isometric projection, navy linework, flat cobalt/light-blue front and side planes, visible restrained vector extrusion, no soft shading or gloss. No supporting platform.
styles.useJa: 構成、仕組み、サービスの関係
styles.traitsJa: 一定の角度と浅い側面

styles.treatment: Fully modeled rounded volume and moderate real thickness, premium matte satin finish, elevated frontal view, upper-left studio light, low-intensity soft contact shadows. No inflated toy forms or plinths.
styles.useJa: 表紙、機能の見出し、強調箇所
styles.traitsJa: 丸みのある立体、控えめな反射

styles.treatment: Front-facing forms with very shallow stacked relief, broad flat front planes, two or three thin layers, short close shadows at overlaps. Not fully rounded 3D and not collage fiber.
styles.useJa: 階層や層のある概念
styles.traitsJa: 薄い層と近い影

styles.treatment: Realistic product miniatures: document is neat ivory office paper stack with navy binder clip; collaboration is two blue office chairs sharing one small pale-blue round table; automation is a compact cobalt motor with ONE sensible connected steel gear; security is a navy physical padlock with a steel shackle. No room, floor plate, display base or brand. Genuine photoreal material and construction. Use the same four semantic concepts as other panels; this one intentionally uses actual objects rather than sculpted abstract glyphs.
styles.useJa: 現実の対象を手掛かりにする説明
styles.traitsJa: 紙、椅子、モーター、錠の実物感

styles.treatment: Mature hand-drawn pen miniature icons, fine line-weight variation, intentional light hatching and restrained pale-blue watercolor wash inside forms. No messy doodles or illustrative background.
styles.useJa: 書籍、編集、親しみのある解説
styles.traitsJa: 線の強弱と軽いハッチング

styles.treatment: Transparent tinted BLUE glass, visible refraction, clear edge thickness, crisp reflective rims, dark legible semantic details, no backdrop glass panels or neon.
styles.useJa: デジタルな軽さを示す主題表現
styles.traitsJa: 透過、屈折、明確な縁

styles.treatment: Blue-anodized brushed metal faces, fine directional brushing and precise modest bevels, restrained neutral steel edges, machined inset detail. Not shiny chrome or toy plastic.
styles.useJa: 精度や工業の質感を示す主題
styles.traitsJa: 切削の面と細い金属の筋

styles.treatment: Thin overlapping cobalt and pale-blue paper cut-outs with subtle visible fibers and a few purposeful torn edges, tiny shadows only at overlaps; flat composition. No folded triangular facets, thick relief or confetti.
styles.useJa: 編集、サステナビリティの表現
styles.traitsJa: 薄い紙の重なりと繊維

styles.treatment: Flat cobalt and navy screen-print silhouettes, visible controlled halftone dots and a few intentional registration offsets, no watercolor, no 3D volume, no distressed scenery.
styles.useJa: 紙面、広報、印刷の質感
styles.traitsJa: 網点と2色の版のずれ

styles.treatment: Crisp folded blue paper forms, few angular triangular/trapezoidal facets and meaningful creases, limited planar shading, sharp fold construction. Not torn collage or smooth curved plastic.
styles.useJa: 構成や組立てを示す主題
styles.traitsJa: 折り目と角のある面

styles.treatment: Rigid thin icon-shaped engineered metal shells with fine cobalt powder-coat orange-peel texture, modest chamfers, only minimal functional fasteners, inset ivory marks. Clearly rough coated surface, not brushed bare metal or smooth porcelain.
styles.useJa: 設備や工業品質の主題
styles.traitsJa: 細かな塗装肌と硬い殻

styles.treatment: Thin shapes made of layered ivory page edges, navy bookcloth and precise small folded spine joins. Page-edge stacks and bookcloth clearly visible. Not torn collage or bulky leather.
styles.useJa: 学習、知識、出版の主題
styles.traitsJa: 紙の層、布、製本の接合

styles.treatment: Thin hard warm-white porcelain silhouettes with cobalt glazed faces and exposed ivory rims, controlled vitreous glaze highlights, clean slender thickness. Not thick inflated clay, not transparent glass.
styles.useJa: 丁寧な工芸や品質の主題
styles.traitsJa: 白い素地と青い釉薬

styles.treatment: Fine-grain structured navy-blue leather cut to icon shapes, thin credible leather edge, sparse neat stitches and debossed ivory semantic marks. No brown leather, no rectangular backing patch, no plush.
styles.useJa: 触感や仕立てを示すブランド表現
styles.traitsJa: 革の粒、薄い縫い目、凹み

styles.treatment: High-density navy/cobalt directional satin stitches, fine thread fibers, ivory semantic marks, clean cut edge following the symbol; thin unstuffed fabric, no surrounding badge or cloth rectangle.
styles.useJa: 素材、手仕事、服飾の主題
styles.traitsJa: 糸の方向と裁ち切った縁

styles.treatment: Crisp square-grid modules with horizontal/vertical stepped boundaries ONLY, approximately 18-to-24 cells across each symbol, navy/cobalt pixels and ivory voids, no antialiased smooth curves or arcade scenery.
styles.useJa: デジタル文化、格子構造の主題
styles.traitsJa: 正方形のモジュールと階段状の外形
